channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sacituzumab tirumotecan improves survival versus platinum chemotherapy in final phase 3 results
item.description: Final company-reported results show sacituzumab tirumotecan improved overall survival versus platinum-based chemotherapy in EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC.

item.title: Tarlatamab plus durvalumab improves survival in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, Amgen reports
item.description: Amgen reported that tarlatamab plus durvalumab improved overall survival versus durvalumab alone in first-line maintenance treatment of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

item.title: Camupepimut fails to improve disease-free survival in pancreatic cancer in phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P trial
item.description: In a randomized phase 2 trial, camupepimut did not improve disease-free survival versus observation in patients with resected KRAS-mutated pancreatic cancer.

item.title: Pulmonary Hypertension-ILD Screening Tool Awaits Further Data
item.description: Interim data from the PHINDER study preview a risk stratification strategy for detecting pulmonary hypertension in patients with interstitial lung disease.
